title: Root context and graph only
description: The file is a JSON object whose top level holds no member other than @context and @graph. Neither is required here: a file with no context, or no graph, passes, and `Tier 4 - USES-TROV-CORRECTLY` is where both are required. A top level that is an array of nodes, or a node written at the top level with its own @id and properties, is refused.
summary: The file is a JSON object whose top level holds no member other than `@context` and `@graph`
